label: Software Engineer | Web Products, AI & Platforms
summary: I build products and reusable systems that help teams deliver. My work spans React and TypeScript interfaces, real-time AI experiences, and deployment platforms that make infrastructure easier to use. I take ownership across product, backend, data, and infrastructure teams, adapting to what the company needs as products evolve.

work.name: rPotential
work.summary: Joined early to build AI-powered decision-support products for executives, then expanded into shared infrastructure and integration across frontend, backend, and data teams.
highlights: Built reusable frontend and backend templates adopted by three teams: frontend, backend, and data. Enabled teams to launch projects without managing the underlying deployment infrastructure.
Built most initial prototypes in React and TypeScript, using Zustand for state management. Approximately half evolved into products before further iteration.
Created real-time AI voice experiences that generated data presentations in response to user requests, addressing latency challenges to improve conversational responsiveness.
Developed Slack-integrated AI for data gathering and user interaction, plus a Twilio and OpenAI Realtime telephone prototype to collect employee information and feedback.
Connected frontend applications to evolving backends and data pipelines, collaborating on integrations requiring restricted source-data access and anonymized downstream information.

work.name: Anaconda
work.summary: Built serverless infrastructure for AI agents and LLM workloads, supporting deployment, orchestration, and integration through OpenAI-compatible interfaces.
highlights: Created reusable deployment workflows and queue-based communication to support rapid agent iteration and asynchronous multi-agent workflows.
Delivered a Slack-integrated agent connected to Jupyter, helping scientists improve notebooks and execute Python from Slack.
Added tracing and monitoring with AWS X-Ray and CloudWatch to support performance analysis and debugging.

work.name: Masterworks
work.summary: Moved from backend engineering into DevOps leadership, building shared infrastructure to improve developer experience and deployment reliability.
highlights: Created automated per-branch environments so teams could develop and validate changes independently.
Migrated frontend hosting to AWS CloudFront, supporting CDN-level A/B testing and performance tuning.
Reworked backend delivery from Jenkins and Kubernetes to GitHub Actions and AWS Fargate, with infrastructure managed through Terraform and AWS CDK.

projects.name: W7S.io
projects.description: Designed and built an open-source deployment platform that lets developers ship full-stack applications directly from GitHub, with infrastructure provisioned through a shared workflow.
highlights: Unified frontend hosting, JavaScript/TypeScript backends, databases, storage, queues, and scheduled workflows so applications can share a consistent path from repository to deployment.
Built GitHub Actions deployment with repository-based OIDC authentication, removing the need for separate deployment API keys.
Integrated usage controls, operational visibility, and a read-only infrastructure API to help developers and AI agents inspect deployments and troubleshoot issues.

projects.name: Democrachain
projects.role: Creator & Developer | Independent platform and working prototype
projects.description: Designed and built a blockchain platform in JavaScript, later evolving it in TypeScript, to help organizations synchronize data across nodes and implement shared business logic through smart contracts.
highlights: Combined synchronization, scoped permissions, and JavaScript smart contracts into a reusable foundation for distributed applications.
Designed the platform to reduce shared-state coordination and cache-management work for application teams.

projects.name: CacheP2P
projects.description: Built a browser-based peer-to-peer CDN using WebRTC, exploring how participating browsers can contribute capacity to content delivery.
